# Fixtures read by the konclave-seal tests

## zip2005_use_qsk.json

ZIP 2005 key derivation vectors with `use_qsk = true` (FROST-controlled accounts), read by
`tests/zip2005_use_qsk.rs`.

- Source: `zcash-sign/tests/fixtures/zip2005_use_qsk.json` in
  [ZcashFoundation/frost-tools PR #610](https://github.com/ZcashFoundation/frost-tools/pull/610),
  head commit `038204d4ff1f58042c54ce55be02336c77e703c6`, copied byte for byte.
- License: frost-tools is dual-licensed, Apache-2.0 or MIT (`LICENSE-APACHE`, `LICENSE-MIT`).
- Its own description says it was generated by zafe-core and is not official. Agreement with it
  means our derivation and zafe-core agree; both use the same crates, and neither is the reference.
- SHA-256 of the copied file: `00b880e4539776f7b2e0e38ea90e1dfc57f790cbb90576d8b01c3da43a1172e5`.

If the PR changes the fixture before it merges, re-copy it, update the commit and the hash here, and
re-run the test.
